subtitle: Language in your conversations
short_description: Chat with friends. Meet new words and short phrases as you read.
description:
Vipi brings a little language into your everyday conversations.

Chat about your plans, your people and your day. Selected words and short phrases switch between your chosen language and their meaning, while the rest of the message stays familiar. Pause the changes or return to the original message whenever you like.

Hear pronunciation with local audio. Reading guides help you follow supported writing systems. Language immersion runs on your device, with available vocabulary and voices depending on your language and downloads.

Vipi is everyday exposure through conversation. It does not provide a structured course or promise fluency.
